items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I played out there with Jake Carey on the drum

ctx.x: Okay, we're talking about the island of Millenburg. Did you ever play there before they tore it down?

Yeah, I played there when they had all of those camps out there. I played out there with Jake Carey on the drum and I played with my arn band out there in Millenburg. Then I played at a white nightclub out there.
Was there a nightclub? They had a nightclub out there. I thought most of these little camps out over the water.
